notes: Build100 introduces an explicit fail-closed Lovable Deployment Adapter. Historical preserved code proves Lovable project read/create/GitSync contracts but no trusted publish transport, and no documented publish endpoint is guessed. The adapter performs project/Git/transaction preflight, requires an explicitly registered homologated transport with publish+verify capability, binds a short-lived one-shot ticket to project+HEAD+preflight fingerprint, requires human confirmation, never retries ambiguous publish outcomes automatically, persists only sanitized deployment receipts, and exposes rollback/redeploy as separate human actions when a future transport declares support. The current package intentionally cannot publish until a verified transport is registered. This package metadata does not authorize OTA, GitHub Release, store publication or merge to main.
